prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity compositional variation for a desktop web application
Primary request: Create compositional option B for PPTExtract's human page-curation workbench. Use the supplied “样片审看室” reference only for its visual world: neutral monitor black, bright script/log paper, teal selection marks, amber pending marks, red exclusion marks, restrained hairlines, compact Chinese typography, and film-review transport grammar. Do not copy the reference topology.
Scene/backdrop: One continuous expert desktop application, straight-on and edge-to-edge, for a curator working for hours at a 1440px monitor.
Subject: A sanitized synthetic Chinese presentation page is the main evidence. Show a title, a bar/line chart, a table and three numbered visual-object boundaries. All data is synthetic and unrelated to medicine or any real fixture.
Style/medium: High-fidelity Web UI mockup in the established sample-review-room world. Dense, precise, professional, implementable with semantic HTML/CSS.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2. Make this structurally different from the reference: a “focus screen + logging desk” topology. The standard page rendering owns the upper 68% of the viewport almost full width on a matte dark monitor surround. A bright horizontal logging desk occupies the lower 26%, divided into three synchronized lanes for 页面总述, 当前视觉对象, and 审核闸门. A very narrow vertical meter at far left shows page 18/43 and changed/pending markers. No large thumbnail filmstrip and no full-height right inspector. The selected object boundary on the page aligns visually to the center logging lane. A thin top timecode/status strip and an always-visible bottom keyboard transport rail frame the screen.
Information requirements: visible 页面总述; visual object 01/02/03 disposition; current object has 纳入/排除, summary, 未确认草稿 and provenance; pending state; validation blocker; actions 批准, 排除, 重新打开; keyboard labels ←/→ 翻页, A 批准, X 排除, R 重新打开. Make inherited prefill distinguishable from confirmed content.
Color palette: #171B20, #E8EBEC, #7CC8C5, #F2B84B, #E05D4D.
Materials/textures: matte neutral monitor surround, crisp script/log paper, subtle grease-pencil ticks. No decorative cinema imagery.
Text (verbatim where legible): "PPTExtract", "第 18 / 43 页", "页面总述", "当前视觉对象 02", "视觉对象 01", "视觉对象 02", "视觉对象 03", "纳入", "排除", "summary", "未确认草稿", "继承预填", "PENDING 待审核", "批准", "重新打开", "A 批准", "X 排除", "← → 翻页".
Constraints: Chinese interface; sanitized synthetic content only; no real filenames, medical themes, people, logos, claims, or personal data. State cannot rely on color alone. Keep the evidence image color-neutral and dominant. Core controls must look buildable in HTML/CSS.
Avoid: copying the reference's bottom thumbnail filmstrip or full-height right inspector, marketing hero, device mockup, surrounding room, people, gradients, glow, neon, glassmorphism, bento cards, oversized typography, excessive rounded corners, generic SaaS dashboard.
